decisions.reason: As a publicly presented flagship of the firm's CO2-negative circular materials direction, with development investment already sunk, management will attribute slow uptake to the early stage of the market and persist for another year, though its distance from the core machinery business raises the risk of withdrawal.

The WASTX Cleanic is a home-page flagship co-developed with partner ERMAFA and sits close to the firm's core plant-engineering competence, so sunk co-development costs and the visible partnership commitment make continuation the clear choice.
